mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces corporate profit growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE > 6.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity and profit pressures, which drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months, combined with a decline in average weekly hours worked (HOUST), signals weakening labor demand and earnings pressure, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.5% for 2 months AND HOUST declines
regime_hint: labor market weakening with falling hours
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 6.5% for two months and HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters, combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST), signals weakening aggregate demand and consumer confidence, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.

regime_hint: demand contraction with falling housing starts
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters and HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05).
